What's your return and refund policy?

If you bought directly from the Oura online store, you can return or exchange a fully functional, undamaged Oura product within 30 days of receiving the original order. Refunds exclude original shipping, handling, and customs fees, and they go back to the original payment method; once the return is received, processing takes up to 14 business days, then it may take a few more business days to appear with your bank. Warranty replacement rings can’t be returned or refunded, and Oura Ring Gen3 purchases aren’t eligible for direct exchanges, so those need to be returned for a refund and reordered if you want a different size, color, or model.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?

Oura’s limited warranty covers manufacturing defects under normal use. New products are covered for 1 year from the purchase date, certified refurbished products are covered for 90 days, and some countries have longer coverage based on local law.
